title_as_printed: The Density of Aqueous Sodium Chloride Solutions
pressure_note: not stated (densities measured with a magnetic float densitometer; no pressure printed, presumably atmospheric)

value.what: 1000 x (density of pure water d0 minus density of solution d); the printed sign is minus so values are 1000(d - d0) positive for denser-than-water solutions. Water reference d0 from Kell (J. Chem. Eng. Data 12, 66 (1967))

composition.other_species: pure water (doubly distilled, degassed); NaCl only

conversion_needs: density unit of the table not printed; check Kell water densities in g/cm3
notes: Layout: three printed column-stacks; blocks 0,5,15,25 down the left column, 25 C continues at the top of the second column (0.052243 ... 0.963647), then 35, 45, 55 C. Written in block order with the 25 C rows contiguous. Whether molality is per kg water is not explicitly stated ('solutions made by weight').
quality_remarks: Density unit is not printed; g/cm3 follows from eq 3 of the paper, phi_V = 1000(d0 - d)/(d d0 m) + M/d (cm3/mol only for d in g/cm3), and a numerical check at 25 C, 0.309342 m (d about 1.0096 g/cm3). Pressure is never stated. Suspected misprint, cell kept: 0 C, m = 0.684443, printed 40.8267 is out of line (0 C, 0.505906: 22.0264; 5 C at the same molality: 28.8041), expected near 30; a density error of roughly 10 kg/m3 if taken as printed.

row_held.reason: printed 40.8267 at 0 C and m 0.684443 is inconsistent with the 5 C value (28.8041) and the neighbouring molalities (expected near 30); probable misprint in the source (audit 2026-10-02)
